warranty: Every closet and cabinet system we install carries a lifetime warranty on its components (panels, shelves, drawers, rods, hinges and hardware) for as long as the original homeowner owns the house, plus one year on our installation workmanship. After that first year a defective part is still free, and a standard service-call fee covers the trip and labor. For accidental damage or normal wear, we order matching parts at our cost and fit them at our regular service rate. The warranty doesn't transfer when the home sells.
custom-closet-cost-nashville: A custom closet's cost in Middle Tennessee comes down to four things: the linear feet of storage, how much of it is drawers and pull-outs instead of open shelving, the materials and finish, and accessories like lighting and hampers. We don't publish ranges. The exact, all-in figure comes from a free in-home design, priced option by option, and it's paid in three parts: half at signing, a quarter when the install is scheduled and a quarter on install day.
closet-cases: Closet Cases is where we write up our own jobs and the questions people ask before buying a closet.
